authorization: User requested automatic travelling-fleet membership for purchased ships, with berthing only by explicit choice.
scope: Newly purchased factory hulls and registry repurchases join the travelling fleet atomically while retaining the current flagship. Explicit berth controls remain available; existing owned hull assignments are preserved. Hull prices, stock, fuel/store allocations, fittings, delivery costs and every generic pricing/production formula remain unchanged.
regressions: purchase-fleet: seven scenarios and all available station/hull combinations
registry stock/progression, historical receipt, full fitting sale/repurchase and conservation tests
Browser purchase/berth/repurchase and desktop source verification recorded in Research/PurchasedFleet-2026-10-28
balanceConsiderations: Fleet cargo, fuel requirements, battle participation and qualifying specialist access now include the purchased hull immediately.
Quarter-tank fuel and existing repair requirements still apply.
The 32-hull registry limit, prices and station stock remain enforced.
limitations: This changes the default fleet assignment only; the old three legacy fleet fixtures still require independent stock/experience and historical-unit updates.
